outcome: Professor extension requests are now compact, science-oriented decision cards
owner_impact: The Professor inbox foregrounds the scientific request name, six-class classification, lifecycle status, concise scientific requirement, Professor note and Approve/Decline actions. Linked papers and Experiments stay attached to one durable request card and are inspectable under Evidence and details. Engineering links are also moved into that disclosure instead of occupying the main decision surface.

next.text: Next is #367, the exact research-AI connector surface cutover: derive the required current tool set, remove obsolete compatibility residue, and verify the actual MCP tools/list and reported counts before fresh-chat acceptance resumes.

technical_evidence: Professor request cards are rendered once per durable capability_requests row; reused capability_request_evidence rows are nested inside the card rather than rendered as additional cards.
Detailed closure evidence is loaded from capability_request_evidence, capability_closure_analyses and blocked_experiment_drafts and remains collapsed by default.
Professor note plus Approve/Decline still call the existing triage_extension_request lifecycle RPC.
The Professor-only profile guard remains unchanged; Student users do not receive the triage surface.
Historical canonical-capability editor UI and the global Development block were removed from the default decision surface without changing request or implementation semantics.
